rule: One colour-1 shape plus single-cell markers. A marker whose row crosses the shape's bounding box gets a left-right mirror of the shape; otherwise its column crosses the box and it gets a top-bottom mirror. The axis is placed so the shape cell on that row/column lands on the marker. The mirror is painted in the marker colour, clipped to the grid, and the original shape stays.
scope: A unique shape cell aligned with each coloured marker anchors an axis reflection. Native 8-connected asymmetric blue shapes have tight 3..5 boxes by default, optional 3..8 boxes, and one marker per distinct side. Native copies are complete, disjoint and separated from the original. Canvas sizes are sampled uniformly from each feasible minimum through 30. All five canonical scenes reconstruct from explicit latent cells and markers.
constraints: All five canonical pairs and 1000 independent seeds 20000..20999 agree with the archived solver.

authored_scope: Random scenes: tight 8-connected random shape (box 3..5, up to 3..8 on request), 1..3 markers by default (up to 4), each on a distinct side (right/left/down/up) with distinct colours 2..9. Grid sized from the required space, 10..30 sampled or exact when requested. Left/up markers and sizes outside 11..16 are synthetic extensions. Explicit shape+markers reproduce the fixtures and may produce clipped copies. Deliberately not supported by default: multi-cell anchor lines (opt-in), clipped or zero-gap sampled copies, multiple markers on the same side, shapes made of several disconnected pieces on the random path.
authored_constraints: Background 0 is the strict most frequent input colour; shape colour 1 strictly outnumbers every marker colour.
Each marker lies outside the shape bounding box and shares a row or column with it.
By default each marker line contains exactly one shape cell.
Copies do not overlap the shape, each other, or other markers, so painting order cannot matter.
Sampled shapes are not symmetric under any requested reflection and have no 180-degree rotational symmetry.
Sampled copies fit fully in the grid, with at least one empty line between each copy and the shape.
All numeric controls are true ints (bool rejected); allow_multi_anchor must be a bool.
All retry loops are bounded (300 scene attempts, 200 shape attempts).
